scientific_integrity: Infinite claims are established by elementary Apéry and binary-composition arguments; finite computation is supplementary. No independent mathematical audit or validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The proof classifies isolated gaps but not all gaps or the full pseudo-Frobenius set. It gives an explicit Frobenius formula only in the two-gap case. Its literature comparison is limited to accessible primary texts and indexed records, with a residual possibility of an unindexed equivalent theorem.
title: A binary-weight classification of isolated gaps in Proth numerical semigroups
